sources.provider: Academia Sinica, Survey Research Data Archive
sources.quality_notes: Dataset-description prose reports completed n=1862, structured sample field n=1881. The 2005 report fieldwork and Q41 tables and 2010 retabulation agree on n=1881. No individual records accessed. Not a separate survey.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Survey respondents naming techniques does not establish any teacher, school, publication or rule transmission edge.
unresolved_lineage_questions: The surveys do not identify the consulted practitioner network or exact Ziwei/Bazi chart method. TW-OPEN-0020 original column and school links remain open.
